title: Tier 1 soft reactivity: shader displacement + tool/verb reactions (AUTH #022)
summary: Ship Tier 1 environment reactivity per SPEC §3.6: object segmentation of the splat plus procedural, shader-driven displacement (NO physics — that is Tier 2/§5). Cushions dent, curtains/plants/paper sway and flutter, cords/soft-hanging swing, dust motes stir — keyed to the scene graph's segmented objects + material labels, and extended to the new verbs/tools (wall-run dust scuff, rappel curtain sway, grapple twine sway). Must hold the 30 fps target (M3 exit).

acceptance_tests.test: Cushions dent, curtains/plants/paper sway and flutter, and cords swing via shader displacement driven by segmentation + material labels, with no rigid/soft-body physics.
Verb/tool reactions land: a wall-run scuffs dust, a rappel sways a curtain, the grapple twine and its anchor object react on mount.
Tier 1 holds the 30 fps target on the Owner's older reference iPhone with Tier 0 + Tier 1 on (M3 exit test; a suggestion-level measurement, not a merge gate per SPEC §11).

history.event: created by the Coordinator as an AUTH #022 follow-up (Tier 1 soft reactivity).
